scope: Historical accepted local run; cumulative delta over timestamped fresh observation windows, including stalls; not a new server run or steady-state benchmark
limitations: Each window starts at the first recorded fresh observation; prior work is excluded.
First observed completion may follow actual completion; reported rates are window averages.
The windows end at different times and are not simultaneous stage rates.
Counters describe staging and validated receipts, not attempts or isolated scan speed.
The full run retained 505 nonfresh pipeline observations; missing observations were not relabeled zero or fresh.
